definitions.gloss: menma, seasoned bamboo shoots for ramen
definitions.explanation: Fermented and seasoned bamboo shoot strips, commonly used as a ramen topping. Also eaten as a side dish or snack with beer.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧メンマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる。
メンマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like the texture of menma.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧メンマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I bought seasoned menma as a snack to go with beer.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the standard toppings for ramen alongside ⟦チャーシュー→チャーシュー：17670_chaashuu⟧ ({叉焼|チャーシュー}), ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧, and {煮卵|にたまご}. Also sold pre-seasoned in packages at supermarkets and convenience stores as a snack or side dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メンマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる (place menma on top)
- ⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧メンマ (seasoned menma)
- メンマ⟦トッピング→トッピング：17674_toppingu⟧ (menma topping)
- ⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧メンマ (homemade menma)

ETYMOLOGY:
A blend of メン (from ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧, ramen) and マ (from {麻|ま}{竹|ちく}, a type of bamboo). Originally called シナチク, but the name was changed as シナ was considered offensive.
